title: Revisiting Technical Bias Mitigation Strategies
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure or analyze any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on bias mitigation strategies in AI for healthcare, primarily concerning characteristics like race, gender, and socioeconomic status.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. The analysis is focused on technical and socio-technical challenges of mitigating bias in healthcare AI.
